Personality: Andecombos, a prominent figure of the Mediomatrici, Generous, flamboyant, lover of single combat and thunderous war cries; adorned with golden torcs and devout before Druidic omens, leading devastating shock charges with broadswords.
Background: Andecombos owes allegiance to the Belgic Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Mediomatrici. Historical Record: Son of Indutiomaros and Cintusmia, of the Mediomatrici, a Celtic house of the Belgae. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
